intro: Flat QoS on VPP: policers, egress rate limits, DSCP / 802.1p / MPLS EXP marking maps and their interface attachments. Changes go to the candidate; commit them from the pending-change bar. Hierarchical QoS and queues are not available (VPP 26.06 has no HQoS scheduler).

state.unavailable: Live policer state is unavailable (agent unreachable or too old); the configuration is still shown.
state.countersError: Counters could not be read from the VPP stats segment: {{error}}

reset.title: Reset {{name}}?
reset.body: Refills the token buckets of the policer in VPP (policer_reset). Counters are kept; they restart only when the policer is re-created or changed.

helper.title: Rate / burst helper
helper.note: Burst = rate × window (bytes for kbit/s, packets for packets/s). “Use” restarts the form below with this rate and burst; a burst below one packet (≈ 1500 bytes) drops every full-size packet.

shapers.title: Rate limits (egress)
shapers.caveat: VPP 26.06 has no queueing shaper outside the excluded HQoS scheduler. A rate limit is realised as an egress policer (single rate, two colours): traffic above the rate is DROPPED, not delayed. It appears in VPP as the policer shaper:<name>.

maps.title: Marking maps
maps.idHelp: VPP egress map id; empty = allocated by the agent
maps.gridHelp: Each cell is a recorded value; type the value to write on egress. Empty cells are not listed (VPP writes 0).
maps.sourceRange: {{source}}: recorded values 0–{{max}}; output values 0–255 (they must fit the marked header)
maps.cellInvalid: Some cells are not a number between 0 and 255.

interfaces.title: Interface attachments
interfaces.recordHelp: Copies the header's DSCP / PCP / EXP into the packet's QoS record
interfaces.storeHelp: VPP 26.06 stores for the IP source only
interfaces.writeOnlyNote: Ingress / egress policer and rate-limit attachments are applied once per VPP start and VPP cannot report them back (write-only, D-063): they are not part of the retrieved state. Record, store and mark are read back from VPP.

help.policer_type: 1r2c = single rate, two colours; 1r3c = RFC 2697; 2r3c = RFC 2698 / RFC 4115 / MEF 5 CF1 (two rates)
help.policer_rateUnit: Rates in kbit/s (bursts in bytes) or packets/s (bursts in packets)
help.policer_eir: Two-rate policers only (RFC 2698: peak rate ≥ CIR; RFC 4115 / MEF: excess rate)
help.shaper_burstBytes: Empty = derived by the agent: ≈ 10 ms of traffic at the rate, at least 3000 bytes
